component.name: PCem
component.summary: PC Emulator for classic IBM PC compatibles

ul.li: Accurate cycle-by-cycle CPU emulation from 8088 to Pentium
Wide range of graphics cards from CGA to 3D accelerators
Sound Blaster, Gravis Ultrasound, and other sound cards
Network support for multiplayer DOS games
